expectation: Membrane ring on nearly all nucleated cells (immune, stromal, endothelial, most tumour). Broad but cell-outlining, not haze. Some tumour nests may be negative or dim, giving sharp B2M-low islands next to bright stroma and immune infiltrates.
observed: A: strong, structured signal in most cores, with sharply bounded dark nests (B2M-low tumour islands) in several. B: membrane outlines on cells in bright bands, next to dimmer nuclei-rich areas. C: dimmer, patchy. D: honeycomb of cell outlines.
why: Membranous cell outlines follow tissue compartments, and some tumour nests are sharply negative, which matches B2M's broad expression and its known loss on some tumour cells.
notes: Bright membrane outlines on stroma and immune-rich areas, next to sharply bounded B2M-low tumour nests in several cores. This is the expected broad pattern with focal loss, not haze or debris.
